decisions.intent: Deliver a complete level-authoring workflow: terrain and all required mission objects are editable/configurable, levels persist and reload, and the authored result plays through the ordinary entry point.
material_capabilities: Placement and configuration of all required mission objects
Save and reload of authored levels
Ordinary-entry-point play of the authored result
decisions.proof_journey: Author a representative level using each required capability; save it, reload it in a fresh session, then launch and play that exact authored level through the ordinary game entry point.
unnecessary_scope: Redesigning unrelated editor or game systems
decisions.rationale: The candidate retains only a small subset of the requested authoring workflow and explicitly leaves terrain and mission objects fixed.

decisions.intent: Make account recovery usable through the normal browser route at phone and desktop sizes, including error recovery and keyboard navigation.
decisions.proof_journey: Exercise the normal account-recovery route in a rendered browser at representative phone and desktop viewports, including an invalid/error path, recovery, and keyboard-only navigation.
decisions.rationale: Code-level checks do not prove routed, rendered responsiveness, recovery behavior, or keyboard usability.

decisions.intent: Verify that the live deployed worker runs the exact reviewed source revision and correctly processes the live contract.
material_capabilities: Identity match to the reviewed revision
Live-contract processing by the deployed worker
decisions.proof_journey: Observe immutable source/version identity from the deployed worker or provider, compare it to the reviewed revision, then exercise and observe the live contract against that deployed instance.
unnecessary_scope: Changing worker behavior before deployment identity is verified
decisions.rationale: Neither local execution nor command success establishes which revision the deployed worker is actually running.

decisions.intent: Complete onboarding so an organisation administrator can invite a member, the member joins, and both receive the correct resulting organisation state.
material_capabilities: Correct post-join organisation state for both actors
decisions.proof_journey: Run an end-to-end two-actor journey: administrator invites, member receives and accepts the invitation, then verify the resulting organisation state from both administrator and member views.
decisions.rationale: The checklist is internally complete, but the defining invitation and joined-state journey was not proven.

decisions.intent: Correct only the misspelled Export label in the accepted settings screen, preserving export behavior and layout.
decisions.proof_journey: Inspect the accepted settings screen with the corrected label and run the focused assertion; confirm the change is text-only and layout/behavior are unchanged.
decisions.rationale: The proposal matches the tightly bounded outcome and supplies proportionate focused proof.

decisions.intent: Replace the legacy importer for every documented customer record shape while preserving validation errors and rollback.
material_capabilities: Replacement support for every documented record shape
decisions.proof_journey: For each documented record shape, run import success and invalid-input cases through the replacement; verify equivalent validation errors and execute rollback after a representative failed or reversed import without using the legacy path.
invalid_substitutes: Leaving other shapes on the legacy path
Leaving rollback on the legacy path
decisions.rationale: A simplest-shape canary is only a subset; the candidate does not replace all documented shapes or carry validation and rollback into the replacement path.
